## Project facts
- Names: Cappella Embassy (renamed 2026), formerly D'Rapport Residences
- Address: Jalan Nipah, off Jalan Ampang, Ampang Hilir, 55000 Kuala Lumpur
- Completed: vacant possession around 2019
- Scale: 9.12 acres, five towers (A to E) of 38 storeys, 1,099 residences
- Layouts: A1 and A2 2,260 sq ft (3+1 bed, 4+1 bath); B 1,927 sq ft (3+1 bed, 4+1 bath); C 1,625 sq ft (3+1 bed, 4+1 bath); D1 1,152 sq ft, D2 1,109 sq ft, D3 1,119 sq ft (2 bed, 2 bath)
- Special layouts: B-T dual key 3,918 sq ft; triplex penthouse 10,635 sq ft
- Facilities: more than 50 across about 280,000 sq ft (about 70,000 sq ft indoors). Level 3 park deck with swimming pool, tennis and basketball courts; Block D Level 2 badminton and squash courts and multipurpose hall; Block D Level 2U gymnasium, yoga room, sauna and golf simulators; Block E Level 2U co-working and games rooms; Block E Level 38A rooftop sky bar and sky deck
- Nearby (approximate): Gleneagles Hospital 350 m, Great Eastern Mall 650 m, The International School of Kuala Lumpur 1.6 km, Petronas Twin Towers 3.9 km, Royal Selangor Golf Club 4.3 km, Pavilion Kuala Lumpur 4.6 km, The Exchange TRX 5.4 km

## FAQ
- Is Cappella Embassy the same as D'Rapport Residences? Yes. D'Rapport Residences was renamed Cappella Embassy in 2026.
- When was it completed? Vacant possession was delivered around 2019, so homes are ready to move in.
- What layouts are there? Seven layouts from 1,109 sq ft (2 bedrooms) to 2,260 sq ft (3+1 bedrooms), plus a 3,918 sq ft dual-key layout and a 10,635 sq ft triplex penthouse.
- How do I get the price list? Send an enquiry on the site or WhatsApp +60 12-657 9508.
